description: R5/M18 (§23, K50, K54): the instrument's story list for an entitled reader (Ana: bars and licensed flow). Every story of THYAO whose life meets the range, closed (with `closed_bar`, `outcome`) and open, licensed flow stories included, each with its face pieces; stories her feed does not show (sensitivity `important`) are listed with `in_feed: false` and the reason. Ranges by bars, last n bars and time; paging (`limit`, `after`, `next`, `total`); English faces; errors (empty range, unknown instrument, limit, cursor, series, two range forms). No bars travel (K23).
name: 60-stories-entitled

steps.note: Ana reads only tier 1 in her feed: every other story is listed with `in_feed: false, hidden: sensitivity` (it is still drawn on the chart, K50).
A short range: every story whose life (birth to close, or to the last closed bar when open) meets the last 25 bars, by birth.
About 50 stories in the last 230 bars, 20 per page: `total` counts the range, `next` is the cursor.
The same short range for an English connection of Ana: the face pieces in English.
A time range past the last bar: empty range (`invalid`).

error.hint: Send the previous answer's `next`, with the same instrument and range.
